records.jp: （あれ？　有理が特待科のクラスに来てるなんて<CR>珍しいかも。話してる相手は……え、更紗！？）
records.en_original: (Huh? It's unusual to see Yuri in the special class... And she's talking to... Wait, Sarasa!?)
records.en_auxiliary: (Huh? It's unusual to see Yuri in the special class. And she's talking to... Wait, Sarasa?!)
records.en: (Huh? It's unusual to see Yuri in the Special Class classroom.<CR>And the person she's talking to is... Wait, Sarasa!?)

records.jp: そうね……。あたしが初めて見た時には<CR>既に同世代の子なんて目じゃないレベルだったから
records.en_original: Right... When I first met her, she was already far beyond the level of anyone else my age.
records.en_auxiliary: Right. When I first met her, she was already far beyond the level of anyone else my age.
records.en: Yes... By the time I first saw her,<CR>she was already far beyond anyone else our age.

records.jp: それよりさらに前となると、ちょっとあたしには<CR>わからないわ。ごめんなさい
records.en_original: But I don't know about anything before that. Sorry.
records.en_auxiliary: But I don't know about anything before that. Sorry.
records.en: Anything before then is beyond me.<CR>I'm sorry.

records.jp: いや、一朝一夕で築かれた動きではないと<CR>わかっただけでも十分な収穫だ。情報、感謝する
records.en_original: Not at all, you've given me plenty of information. It's good to know her skills were not developed overnight. Thank you.
records.en_auxiliary: Not at all, you've given me plenty of information. It's good to know her skills were not developed overnight. Thank you.
records.en: No, learning that her movements were not built overnight<CR>is already a valuable result. Thank you for the information.

records.jp: えっと……二人とも、何の話してるの？
records.en_original: Um... What are you two talking about?
records.en_auxiliary: Um, what are you two talking about?
records.en: Um... What are you two talking about?

records.jp: あら日菜子。ちょうどいいところに来たわ。<CR>こういうのは本人に聞くのが一番早いもの
records.en_original: Ah, speak of the devil. I'll let Yuri explain.
records.en_auxiliary: Ah, speak of the devil. I'll let Yuri explain.
records.en: Oh, Hinako. Perfect timing.<CR>It will be quickest to ask the person herself.

records.jp: 君のことについて尋ねていたんだ。<CR>主にバレエに関することをね
records.en_original: I was asking about you. Mostly in regards to your ballet.
records.en_auxiliary: I was asking about you. Mostly in regards to your ballet.
records.en: We were discussing you.<CR>Primarily matters related to ballet.

records.jp: わ、私のこと？　それもバレエって……。<CR>有理、バレエに興味があるの？
records.en_original: A-about me? And ballet... Are you interested in ballet, Yuri?
records.en_auxiliary: A-about me? And ballet? Are you interested in ballet, Yuri?
records.en: A-about me?<CR>And ballet... Are you interested in ballet, Yuri?

records.jp: いや、バレエそのものというわけではないんだ
records.en_original: No, not particularly.
records.en_auxiliary: No, not particularly.
records.en: No, not ballet itself.

records.jp: 君はリフレクターに変身した時にバレエの動きを取り入れて<CR>いるだろう？　戦っている間も随分華麗に動くものだと思ってね
records.en_original: But you do ballet moves when you transform into a Reflector, right? Your movements during combat are rather elegant.
records.en_auxiliary: But you do ballet moves when you transform into a Reflector, right? Your movements during combat are rather elegant.
records.en: You incorporate ballet movements when you transform into a Reflector, correct?<CR>Your movements in battle are remarkably graceful.

records.jp: バレエをしているからとはいえ、<CR>たやすく戦闘に活かせるとは思えない
records.en_original: But ballet isn't typically considered a martial art.
records.en_auxiliary: But ballet isn't typically considered a martial art.
records.en: Even with a background in ballet,<CR>I doubt it would be easy to apply it in combat.

records.jp: そこで、どれほどバレエの才能や練習量があれば<CR>それが可能になるのか気になったというわけだ
records.en_original: I wanted to know how much ballet talent and practice would be required to make such an approach viable.
records.en_auxiliary: I wanted to know how much ballet talent and practice would be required to make such an approach viable.
records.en: So I wanted to know how much talent and training in ballet<CR>would be required to make that possible.

records.jp: どうして可能なのかって……。<CR>うーん、心当たりがあるとすれば――
records.en_original: So, you want to know why I fight the way I do?
records.en_auxiliary: So, you want to know why I fight the way I do?
records.en: How is it possible...?<CR>Hmm, if I had to think of a reason—

records.jp: 才能とかよりも、バレエをまた踊りたいから……かな。<CR>リフレクターの衣装もチュチュみたいだしね
records.en_original: Maybe it's less about talent, and more because I want to dance ballet...? My Reflector outfit is like a tutu as well.
records.en_auxiliary: Maybe it's less about talent and more because I want to dance ballet? My Reflector outfit is like a tutu as well.
records.en: Rather than talent, maybe it's because I want to dance ballet again.<CR>My Reflector outfit looks like a tutu too.

records.jp: 想いの力で戦うのがリフレクターだし、<CR>私の想いが動きや衣装にも現れてるんだと思う
records.en_original: Reflectors fight with the power of feelings, so I think my feelings are, well, reflected in my movements and outfit.
records.en_auxiliary: Reflectors fight with the power of feelings, so I think my feelings are, well, reflected in my movements and outfit.
records.en: Reflectors fight with the power of feelings,<CR>so I think my feelings show through in my movements and outfit.

records.jp: もちろん、体がバレエに慣れてないと動きは出てこないと<CR>思うけど、やっぱりそれよりも気持ちが大きいんじゃないかな
records.en_original: Of course, I probably couldn't move like that without being used to ballet, but I think my feelings are more important.
records.en_auxiliary: Of course, I probably couldn't move like that without being used to ballet, but I think my feelings are more important.
records.en: Of course, I don't think those movements would come naturally if my body weren't accustomed to ballet,<CR>but I think my feelings matter even more.

records.jp: 日菜子……
records.en_original: Hinako...
records.en_auxiliary: Hinako...
records.en: Hinako...

records.jp: なるほど、それも想いがなせる業か……<CR>想いが動きに影響するとは、実に興味深い
records.en_original: I see. Feelings can influence your movements, too. How interesting.
records.en_auxiliary: I see. Feelings can influence your movements, too. How interesting.
records.en: I see, so this too is the work of feelings...<CR>The idea that feelings influence movement is fascinating.

records.jp: こ、こんな感じの答えでいい……かな？<CR>ちゃんと答えになってる？
records.en_original: I-Is that good enough...? Did I answer your question?
records.en_auxiliary: I-is that clear enough? Did I answer your question?
records.en: I-Is that a good enough answer...?<CR>Did I actually answer your question?

records.jp: ああ、十分だ。想いや感情について、<CR>また一つ新たな発見を得られた
records.en_original: Yes, it's plenty. I've made another discovery about thoughts and emotions.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes, it's plenty. I've made another discovery about thoughts and emotions.
records.en: Yes, more than enough.<CR>I have made another discovery about feelings and emotions.

records.jp: きっと合ってると思うわ。<CR>そのために戦ってるんだもの
records.en_original: And it makes total sense to me. Ballet's the reason why you're fighting, after all.
records.en_auxiliary: And it makes total sense to me. Ballet's the reason why you're fighting, after all.
records.en: I'm sure that's right.<CR>After all, that's what you're fighting for.

records.jp: うん、そうだね……
records.en_original: Yeah, it is...
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, it is.
records.en: Yeah... That's right.

records.jp: ……さて、私はこの発見をまとめてくるとしようか
records.en_original: ...Anyway, I need to go aggregate my findings.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Anyway, I need to go aggregate my findings.
records.en: Now then, I shall go compile this discovery.

records.jp: 二人とも、今日は参考になった。それでは
records.en_original: You've both been very helpful today. See you.
records.en_auxiliary: You've both been very helpful today. See you.
records.en: Both of you were very helpful today. Farewell.

records.jp: これまでバレエに関すること以外はしてこなかったから<CR>自然とそういう動きになるのかも
records.en_original: Up until recently, everything I did was ballet-related, so I might just naturally move that way.
records.en_auxiliary: Up until recently, everything I did was ballet-related, so I might just naturally move that way.
records.en: Until now, everything I did was related to ballet,<CR>so perhaps I simply move that way naturally.

records.jp: ふむ……やはり経験の賜物、というわけか。<CR>ということは、身体能力と練習の質と量を分析すれば……
records.en_original: Hm... So it's the result of your experience. If I analyze your physical abilities and quantify your practice...
records.en_auxiliary: Hm. So it's the result of your experience. If I analyze your physical abilities and quantify your practice...
records.en: Hmm... So it is the result of experience after all.<CR>Then if I analyze your physical ability and the quality and quantity of your training...

records.jp: あ、あはは……分析しても、<CR>そんなに面白い結果にはならないんじゃないかな……？
records.en_original: Er... Ahaha... I don't think you'll get any interesting results from analyzing me...
records.en_auxiliary: Er... Ahaha... I don't think you'll get any interesting results from analyzing me.
records.en: A-Ahaha...<CR>I don't think analyzing me will produce very interesting results...

records.jp: あら、でも日菜子がこれまでどういう練習をしてきたか<CR>解明するのはいいことだと思うわ
records.en_original: Oh? But I think it would be good to know just how much you've practiced up until now, Hinako.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh? But I think it would be good to know just how much you've practiced up until now, Hinako.
records.en: Oh, but I think it would be useful to determine exactly what training<CR>you have done up to this point.

records.jp: バレエをしている人みんなが気になることでしょうし、<CR>あたしも参考に出来るところは参考にしたいもの
records.en_original: I think everyone in ballet is curious about that, and I'd like as much reference as I can get.
records.en_auxiliary: I think everyone in ballet is curious about that, and I'd like as much reference as I can get.
records.en: Everyone who practices ballet would be interested,<CR>and I would like to use whatever I can as reference too.

records.jp: さ、更紗……？
records.en_original: Wait, who's analyzing me again?
records.en_auxiliary: Wait, who's analyzing me again?
records.en: S-Sarasa...?

records.jp: 決まりだな。さっそく君の身体能力を測定し、質疑で<CR>これまでの練習メニューとかけた時間を全て明らかにしよう
records.en_original: It's decided. I'll measure your physical abilities, then question you about your time spent in training.
records.en_auxiliary: It's decided. I'll measure your physical abilities, then question you about your time spent in training.
records.en: Then it is decided. First I shall measure your physical abilities,<CR>then question you to establish every training regimen and the time you spent on it.

records.jp: 生まれつきの資質も影響するだろうから、遺伝情報も必要だな。<CR>だとするとＤＮＡの採取及びその塩基配列の分析も――
records.en_original: It's possible some of your qualities are genetic, so I'll have to collect and sequence your DNA...
records.en_auxiliary: It's possible some of your qualities are genetic, so I'll have to collect and sequence your DNA.
records.en: Innate qualities may also play a role, so I will need genetic information.<CR>That means collecting your DNA and analyzing its base sequence—

records.jp: い、忙しいから、そういうのはまた今度で……！
records.en_original: I-I'm busy right now, maybe another day...!
records.en_auxiliary: I-I'm busy right now! Maybe another day!
records.en: I-I'm busy right now. Maybe another day...!

records.jp: むう。それは実に残念だ
records.en_original: Grr. How truly unfortunate.
records.en_auxiliary: Darn. How truly unfortunate.
records.en: Hmm. That is truly unfortunate.

records.jp: （ゆ、有理も更紗も、本気だった……）
records.en_original: (Y-Yuri and Sarasa were both serious...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Y-Yuri and Sarasa were both serious.)
records.en: (Y-Yuri and Sarasa were both serious...)

records.jp: それは――
records.en_original: Well...
records.en_auxiliary: Well...
records.en: That—
